# Check current red block positions relative to white character
seg = current_frame.segmentation
white = None
reds = []
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'W' and n['pixels'] > 50:
        white = n
    elif n['color'] == 'R':
        reds.append(n)

if white:
    b = white['boundary']
    min_r = min(p[0] for p in b)
    max_r = max(p[0] for p in b)
    min_c = min(p[1] for p in b)
    max_c = max(p[1] for p in b)
    print(f"White: ({min_r},{min_c})-({max_r},{max_c})")
    for r in reds:
        rb = r['boundary']
        rmin_r = min(p[0] for p in rb)
        rmax_r = max(p[0] for p in rb)
        rmin_c = min(p[1] for p in rb)
        rmax_c = max(p[1] for p in rb)
        print(f"  Red: ({rmin_r},{rmin_c})-({rmax_r},{rmax_c}), {r['pixels']}px")
        # Check if red is inside white's bounding box
        inside = (rmin_r >= min_r and rmax_r <= max_r and rmin_c >= min_c and rmax_c <= max_c)
        print(f"    Inside white bbox: {inside}")

# Try moving RIGHT to see if red blocks move away
result = action(['RIGHT'])

white = None
reds = []
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'W' and n['pixels'] > 50:
        white = n
    elif n['color'] == 'R':
        reds.append(n)
if white:
    b = white['boundary']
    min_r = min(p[0] for p in b)
    max_r = max(p[0] for p in b)
    min_c = min(p[1] for p in b)
    max_c = max(p[1] for p in b)
    print(f"After RIGHT, White: ({min_r},{min_c})-({max_r},{max_c})")
    for r in reds:
        rb = r['boundary']
        rmin_r = min(p[0] for p in rb)
        rmax_r = max(p[0] for p in rb)
        rmin_c = min(p[1] for p in rb)
        rmax_c = max(p[1] for p in rb)
        print(f"  Red: ({rmin_r},{rmin_c})-({rmax_r},{rmax_c})")

# Now try SPACE
result = action(['SPACE'])
